integrity: The exact finite enumerator, deterministic acyclic matching, signed Morse boundary projection and independent full mod-two simplicial ranks are included. All stated computations were executed on the embedded program files prior to acceptance.
scientific_limitations: Single graph and the complete induced-forest stage only; no general family theorem or automorphism-character determination. Originality against unindexed work is not guaranteed.
title: Mixed-dimensional homotopy of the Möbius–Kantor induced-forest complex
